name: Entity Enricher · 05 — 3 samples → a saved schema (scenario-001 authoring)

mapper.request:
Chemical element.

Every property must be a settled, public fact a reference work states for ANY well-known instance of this type — never operational or time-varying data (prices, stock, opening hours, current staff). Leave a property null in a sample when that instance legitimately lacks it, so the schema marks it nullable instead of required. Include: two identifying properties on the root, one multilingual free-text description, one array of strings, one array of objects owned by this entity (its parts — e.g. isotopes), and at least two nested objects describing things that exist independently and recur across instances (a discoverer, a laboratory, a category), each with its own identifying field. Nest at least three levels deep.

designer.name: Generate Sample — 3 distinct instances, one field set
Generate Schema — union of the 3 samples, auto-saved
